read_only_coordinator_review.conclusion: No additional blocking defect found within the requested static scope; this review is separate from the paired tests and is not a new product execution proof.

findings.evidence: cpu_phase.iteration returns for ReadEvidence/SelectEvidence before budget.record_decision/reserve, claim, executor.launch, or _cpu_once_dispatched. Continuations reuse the bounded private queue and skip ingress. Native harvest/Stop checks remain at the top of the ordinary loop.

BoundPolicy captures detached snapshot and budget before callback; cpu_phase keeps independent queue/proposal_snapshot, verifies the pager after callback, and only then accepts a decision. Selected references cause a current terminal metadata re-read, not admission authority. Propose/Replicate still invoke the existing source and expected full-Ref checks.

EvidencePager verifies exact PID, Lake/connection, route, total_changes, data_version and schema_version before/after page collection; an intervening SQL write is HOLD, not silent cursor reconstruction. Private random one-use cursors are pager-local. A normal decision releases the current scan; the next ordinary policy decision starts a new scan.

close releases the read-only pager/request/queue before cleanup. Unconfirmed native stop retains its owner/permit and raises; interface/policy and own signal/atexit roots are released only on successful cleanup. Releasing read state is not evidence of native closure.

limits: The scan enumerates current-generation terminal action rows, not all historical attempts. traversal_end is not scientific convergence, statistical independence, or permanent file validity.

Conservative staleness can also follow the coordinator's own active-handle harvest or an unrelated SQL write. A custom trusted policy may issue repeated bounded selections; this change supplies bounded access, not a universal policy termination proof.
recorded_proposals still has its existing bounded view. Pro's named research roles do not consume this CPU paging API; this does not establish unified full-product long-horizon planning.

bounds: Exactly the four requested pre-existing Core modules: test_sweeper.py, test_evolution.py, test_fsm_runner_registry.py and test_skill_registry.py. All 31 collected cases passed without exclusion or skip.
